request: B: Sim is REAL now, same API as the stub. World coords: Lost Property car spans x 3600-5400. bin spot car_lp_s3 x=4350, bench x=4085 (Sim.get_bench_x()), counter 4800 (get_counter_x()), attendant start 4500, door 5340 (get_door_x()), queue slots every 90px from 4800 toward the door. (1) Your shots: m1_claimant_bubble uses player_move_to(3500) which is the sleeper car; use ~4500. m1_bench_tool: item ids are 'i101','i102'... not 'i_100' - use setup call Sim.pick_up('car_lp_s3') then Sim.place_on_bench('i101') (first item of a fresh game is i101). For m2_car_pass/m2_car_dine add setup call Sim.skip_tutorial first, otherwise walking is clamped to the LP car until the first delivery (by design). Cheats.run('trigger_first_minute') is not implemented yet (stub). (2) New API you can use: Sim.get_tutorial() -> {stage: find_item|to_bench|examine|hand_over|sweep|done, target_x, target_spot, hint}; Sim.get_highlights() -> [{kind: spot|passenger|bench|shelf|x, id}] (what should glow; never empty for >8s; spots shimmer after 6s idle); Sim.get_queue() -> [pid]; Sim.put_on_shelf(iid); Sim.skip_tutorial(). (3) Passenger states emitted via Events.passenger_state_changed: seated, standing_up, walking, queued, at_counter, asking, waiting, receiving, leaving. Extra keys on passenger dicts: leave_mood (happy|sad|annoyed) for the leaving animation, t, asked. passenger_left fires AFTER they have walked off past the door. Bram spawns at the door at t=5s, speaks (passenger_said) at ~9s. (4) Clue signal is Events.clue_revealed_v2(iid, clue). reveal() requires the item to be ON THE BENCH. place_on_bench caps at 3. Save file is user://save_v2.json (v1 user://save.json is read once for migration). (5) Not drawn yet by your world: passengers/items/Bram (no actors in the screenshots).
